brief.summary: Equities push toward records with the Nasdaq at all-time highs while Treasury yields sit near multi-decade highs, with 10s around 5.27 and 30s near 5.64 after a modest morning pullback. The curve retains a steepening bias on long-end supply and a mismatch of buyers and sellers. The dollar is favored as the euro weakens on European fiscal and political stress, while oil slips under $100 on Red Sea progress. The Fed is framed as still tightening, with markets pricing three hikes though officials flag no urgency and a possible October skip. The dominant narrative is a powerful AI-driven capex and earnings boom colliding with a bond-market repricing that has not yet broken risk assets; tone is cautiously risk-on.
